Subject: Important Update: Workshop Schedule Adjustment

Dear Participants,

We are writing to inform you of a slight adjustment to the upcoming workshop schedule. To enhance the learning experience, the practical session has been moved to the afternoon. Please note that registration will still begin at 8:45 AM sharp, so we encourage you to arrive on time to settle in comfortably.

Lunch will be provided for all attendees during the midday break, allowing you to network and recharge without leaving the venue. Additionally, please remember to bring your fully charged laptops, as they are essential for the hands-on activities planned for the afternoon session. We apologize for any inconvenience this change may cause and look forward to seeing you there.

Best regards,

The Workshop Team
task: Write a professional email explaining a fictional workshop schedule change: the practical session moves to the afternoon, registration remains at 8:45, lunch is included, and participants should bring laptops.
